An initial script assumed four tasks although this saved plan contained two; the assertion was corrected against the stored result.
On initial refresh the shared 127.0.0.1 origin restored another synthetic account and returned 404. Cause was not fully established; localhost storage isolation recovered the intended account.
A full-page capture fell back to a viewport and a later viewport screenshot timed out. These capture failures are not counted as application failures or successful captures.
